Boxing competitions
Main article: Boxing at the 2020 Summer Olympics – Qualification
2020 Asia & Oceania Boxing Olympic Qualification Tournament
VenuePrince Hamzah Sport Hall
LocationAmman, Jordan
Dates3–11 March
Competitors221 from 35[1] nations

The 2020 Asia & Oceania Boxing Olympic Qualification Tournament for boxing at the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo, Japan,[2] were held from 3 to 11 March 2020 at the Prince Hamzah Sport Hall in Amman, Jordan.[3]

The tournament was originally scheduled to be held in Wuhan, China from February 3–14, 2020 but was cancelled by local organizers amidst concerns over the COVID-19 pandemic, believed to have originated from the city.[4] The qualifiers were moved to Jordan.[5]
